text: dsh-compressio 是为 DeepSeek Harness 接入图片处理工具的插件包。它通过 bundle 注册名为 compressio 的 streamable HTTP MCP 客户端，连接 api.compressio.cc。可用工具包括压缩 JPEG/PNG、在 JPEG/PNG/WebP 间转换、无损优化 PNG，以及查看图片格式、尺寸和文件大小。适合需要在 DSH 对话中处理图片的用户；配置未声明 API Key，但图像处理请求发往托管服务。

dsh-compressio adds image tools to DeepSeek Harness through a hosted MCP service. It documents JPEG/PNG compression, JPEG/PNG/WebP conversion, lossless PNG optimization, and image metadata inspection. The bundle connects to api.compressio.cc and declares no API key.

能不能把 PNG 图片转成 WebP，或者在常见图片格式间转换？
I need to inspect an image’s format, dimensions, and file size from my DSH workflow.
dsh-compressio 的功能「图片压缩与转换」：通过注册的 MCP 工具压缩 JPEG/PNG、在 JPEG、PNG、WebP 格式间转换、无损优化 PNG，并查看图片格式、尺寸和文件大小；工具由远端 MCP 服务提供。

into your DSH profile as four tools:

dsh-compressio README · dsh-compressio — Image Compression & Conversion for DeepSeek Harness：| Tool (as seen by the model) | What it does |
|---|---|
| `mcp__compressio__compress_image` | Compress JPEG/PNG to a target size/quality |
| `mcp__compressio__convert_image` | Convert between JPEG / PNG / WebP formats |
| `mcp__compressio__optimize_image` | Lossless PNG optimization (OxiPNG) |
| `mcp__compressio__inspect_image` | Image metadata: format, dimensions, file size |

dsh-compressio README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/zhaoyaqi18/dsh-compressio
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-compressio
dsh --profile <name>
```

The upstream MCP server is hosted and always-on — no local engine, no dependencies.

dsh-compressio README · Usage example：> "Compress this photo to under 200KB: ./photo.jpg"

The agent calls `mcp__compressio__compress_image` and returns the compressed file.

dsh-compressio README · Limits & pricing：- **Anonymous**: 20 free calls/day per IP — perfect for trying it out.
- **Pro Key**: $9.90/month, 5,000 calls — [buy on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/s/54e3a23a20).
- Web app (browser-side, files never leave your device): [compressio.cc](https://compressio.cc).

When the free quota runs out, the API itself tells the AI where to go (buy a key or use the free web app) — no dead ends.

dsh-compressio README · Why CompressIO?：- Real WASM encoders (the same ones powering Google Squoosh) — measured **81.7%** compression on a test JPEG.
- Privacy-first: files are processed in memory, not stored.
- Works from anywhere: Claude, Hermes, DSH, or any MCP client.
